people.name: Viengsay Valdés
people.title: directora
previously: Assistant artistic director, Ballet Nacional de Cuba (2019)

basis: Prensa Latina (29 June 2026 and 23 March 2025) names Viengsay Valdés as director of the Ballet Nacional de Cuba; OnCuba (January 2019) reports her appointment as assistant artistic director. The company site could not be reached and no opened page dates her start as director.
Prensa Latina reports of 23 October 2025 and 11 December 2025 name Omar Valiño as director of the Biblioteca Nacional de Cuba José Martí; the library site could not be reached.

people.name: Nelson Ramírez de Arellano
people.title: director
previously: Chief curator, Fototeca de Cuba (2001 to 2010)

basis: Brasil de Fato (25 November 2024) names Nelson Ramírez de Arellano as director of the 15th Havana Biennial, which the Centro Wifredo Lam organises; Prensa Latina (26 March 2026) names him as director of the Centro Wifredo Lam, speaking on the Biennial.

people.name: Fabián Betancourt
people.title: director de la Casa Museo Oswaldo Guayasamín

basis: Prensa Latina (14 May 2026, and 10 March 2025) names Fabián Betancourt as director of the Casa Museo Oswaldo Guayasamín in Havana.

people.name: Abel Prieto
people.title: presidente de la Casa de las Américas
previously: President director, José Martí Cultural Society

basis: Prensa Latina (20 April 2026) names Abel Prieto as president of Casa de las Américas; OnCuba (10 December 2019) reports him presented as the new president after the death of Roberto Fernández Retamar, with his earlier posts.

people.name: Nelson Ramírez de Arellano
people.title: director
previously: Chief curator, Fototeca de Cuba (2001 to 2010)

basis: Prensa Latina (26 March 2026) names Nelson Ramírez as director of the Centro de Arte Contemporáneo Wifredo Lam; Brasil de Fato (November 2024) gives his full name as the centre's and the Biennial's director, and My Art Guides lists his Fototeca posts.

people.name: Luciano Castillo
people.title: director de la Cinemateca de Cuba

basis: Prensa Latina (27 March 2026) names Luciano Castillo as director of the Cinemateca de Cuba.
Prensa Latina (22 May 2026) names Renier Rodríguez as director of EGREM; no opened page says when Mario Escalona, named director general in 2018, left, so he is not listed.

Prensa Latina (23 February 2025) names Juan Rodríguez Cabrera as president of the fair's organising committee; Prensa Latina in August 2026 names him as president of the Instituto Cubano del Libro opening and speaking for the 2026 fair.
Prensa Latina (14 October 2026) names Víctor Rodríguez as president of the Jazz Plaza festival's organising committee.
Prensa Latina (4 December 2025) names Tania Delgado as the festival's director at its press conference.

people.name: Lissette Solórzano
people.title: directora de la Fototeca de Cuba

basis: Prensa Latina (25 October and 11 November 2025) names the photographer Lissette Solórzano as director of the Fototeca de Cuba.
